title: Docker Cleanup
description: Identify and remove stopped Docker containers and unused resources with configurable safety.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "Stopped containers:"
docker ps -aq --filter status=exited || true

echo
echo "Dangling images:"
docker images -q --filter dangling=true || true

if [[ "${DRY_RUN:-true}" == "true" ]]; then
    echo
    echo "DRY_RUN=true: no Docker resources were removed."
    exit 0
fi

docker container prune -f
docker image prune -f

echo "Docker cleanup completed."
